item.title: In a Post-Roe America, Knowledge Isn’t Just Power – It’s Survival
item.description: Trump doesn’t need to sign a national abortion ban to wreak havoc. He and his allies are already gutting protections through rollbacks.

item.title: Trump has now crossed the red line which demands his indictment ASAP
item.description: The prospect of encouraging the oil companies to go in there before the government is stabilized is highly problematical.

item.title: Echoes of History: How Fascism Seizes Control
item.description: Essential to American fascism, Republicans envision a strong-man Dear Leader who will hold power for as long as he chooses.

item.title: Unprincipled and Unashamed
item.description: The problem with people who lack knowledge and critical thinking ability is that they make poor decisions and are easily fooled and manipulated.

item.title: Chevron and the other major oil companies can be heroes! But will they?
item.description: Trump says that oil companies will be running down to Venezuela to take advantage of the wonderful opportunity to restore the dilapidated oil.

item.title: The Inquisition and witch hunts marred Europe for centuries
item.description: After killing Muslims in Crusades and Jews in massacres, Christians began murdering fellow Christians who deviated from official dogma.

item.title: Trump’s attempts at foreign policy forecast immediate and long-term trouble for the United States
item.description: One of America’s greatest assets in the recent past has been its system of alliances with other countries, such as NATO. Trump disapproves.

item.title: Could Trump in the midterms be indicted by Congress if massive screams came from us and responsible mass media?
item.description: There should be no time to lose in demanding that the spineless GOP senators quickly indict and evict Trump.

item.title: The Global Catholic Church is Losing Members Because of the Clerical Sexual Torture of Children
item.description: The Catholic Church has created a global catastrophe through its careful maintenance of a system that has allowed clergy to abuse children.

item.title: Overpopulation: The Global Challenge and Its Far-reaching Impacts
item.description: Overpopulation exerts pressure on the environment, exacerbating the depletion of natural resources, and contributing to ecological degradation.
